title: NRLM Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
summary: NRLM Karnataka is recruiting for 1 post of Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods with a salary of 25000. Candidates must have relevant qualifications and experience, and applications are open from 27 November 2026 to 12 December 2026.
qualification: M.Sc. (Agri) or B.Sc. (Agri) or any Master's degree with relevant experience
how_to_apply: Sign in to an existing account or create a new account on the recruitment portal.
Use the Sign In to Apply option to submit the application before the deadline.
overview: The National Rural Livelihoods Mission Karnataka is seeking to appoint a Block Manager - Farm Livelihoods in Bangarapet taluka, Kolar district. The role involves overseeing farm livelihood initiatives, contributing to rural development, and supporting local farmers in enhancing their agricultural practices.

Candidates interested in applying must hold an M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Agriculture or any Master's degree coupled with relevant experience. Ensure to check the official notification for details on the selection process and other requirements before submitting your application between 27 November 2026 and 12 December 2026.
eligibility_notes: Applicants must possess a Master's degree in a related field or an equivalent qualification in Agriculture, along with pertinent experience.

hi.title: NRLM ब्लॉक मैनेजर - फार्म आजीविका भर्ती 2026 – ऑनलाइन आवेदन करें

title: Doon University Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
summary: Doon University will hold a walk-in interview for one Project Assistant post on 30 November 2026. Candidates with a qualifying M.Sc. in Chemistry and other relevant qualifications are invited for the interview.
qualification: M.Sc. in Chemistry with 60% marks or CGPA of 6.5, valid CSIR/UGC-NET/JRF or GATE qualification
how_to_apply: Report to the venue by 10:00 AM on 30 November 2026
Bring required documents including recent photograph and proof of qualifications
overview: Doon University is seeking a qualified candidate for the position of Project Assistant. The role involves supporting various research activities and projects within the department. Interested individuals should prepare for a walk-in interview scheduled for 30 November 2026 in Dehradun.

To be eligible for the position, candidates must have an M.Sc. in Chemistry with at least 60% marks or a CGPA of 6.5, along with a valid CSIR/UGC-NET/JRF or GATE qualification. Please refer to the official notification for additional details and any updates related to the application process.
eligibility_notes: Candidates must hold an M.Sc. in Chemistry and a valid qualification as specified. Check the official notification for any updates on the application process.
